title: One day too many
description: A billing window leaks its final day. Repair half-open UTC date ranges, including leap days and reversed intervals.
contract: Return calendar dates as YYYY-MM-DD for the half-open interval [start, end), using UTC arithmetic. Both inputs must be real calendar dates in strict YYYY-MM-DD format (years 1000–9999). Equal endpoints return []; reversed endpoints and invalid dates throw RangeError.
